title: CLCON/707/2019 of RAJENDRA RAM Vs MUKUL SATI

paras.text:
CLCON No.707 of 2019
Honíble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Ms. Sudha Tamta, Advocate, holding
brief of Mr. Vinay Kumar, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. Pradeep Hariya, Standing Counsel
for the State of Uttarakhand.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
Writ Petition (S/S) No. 1217 of 2019
filed by the petitioner was disposed by Writ
Court vide order dated 27.05.2019 with a
direction to Additional Director of
Education, Kumaon to examine petitionerís
claim for appointment against any unfilled
vacancy reserved for S.C. Category. Order
dated 27.05.2019 is extracted below:
ìPetitioner participated in a selection
for the post of Assistant Teacher, L.T.
Grade (Arts). Petitioner belongs to S.C.
category. According to the petitioner,
there were as many as 13 vacancies
on the post of Assistant Teacher, L.T.
Grade (Arts), which were reserved for
S.C. category candidates in Kumaon
region and petitioner, as per his
ranking in the merit list, stood
immediately below the last selected
candidate.
Learned counsel for the petitioner
submits that Km. Renuka, another
S.C. category candidate, who was
selected and recommended for the
post of Assistant Teacher, L.T. Grade
(Arts) for Kumaon region, has not
turned up so far for joining before the
appointing authority i.e. Additional
Director, Education, Kumaon,

therefore, petitioner, being the next
candidate in the merit list, should be
offered appointment.
Admittedly, Km. Renuka, who has
been recommended for appointment in
Kumaon Region is higher in merit as
compared to the petitioner, therefore,
she has a preferential right of
appointment. In case, Km. Renuka is
not willing to accept appointment as
contended by the petitioner, then
petitionerís case has to be considered
provided there is no other candidate,
who is above the petitioner amongst
S.C. category candidate as per merit
list and who has opted for Kumaon
region.
Learned counsel for the petitioner
submits that the writ petition may be
disposed of with a direction to the
appointing authority i.e. Additional
Director of Education, Kumaon to
examine the matter and take
appropriate decision.
Accordingly, the writ petition is
disposed of with a direction to the
Additional Director of Education,
Kumaon to examine the matter and if
any vacancy reserved for S.C.
Category candidate remains unfilled
due to non joining of
selected/recommended candidate,
then he shall inform about such
vacancy to the Selecting
Body/Uttarakhand Subordinate
Service Selection Commission. The
Selecting Body shall thereafter
recommend the next S.C. candidate in

the merit list for appointment in
Kumaon Region. This exercise shall be
completed within three months.î
 In this Contempt Petition, it is alleged
that the order passed by Writ Court has
been willfully disobeyed, inasmuch as,
petitioner has not been appointed despite
availability of vacancies.
Learned Standing Counsel was asked
to get instructions in the matter.
Today, learned Standing Counsel, on
instructions, would submit that Km.
Renuka, belonging to S.C. Category who
scored higher marks than the petitioner,
had submitted joining against the post for
which she was selected, thus, there is no
vacancy left on which petitioner could be
considered for appointment. Thus,
according to learned Standing Counsel,
Additional Director of Education, Kumaon
had examined the claim of the petitioner;
but, due to non availability of any vacancy
reserved for S.C. Category candidate,
appointment letter could not be issued to
the petitioner. Thus, according to him, this
is not a case of willful disobedience.
I find force in the contention made by
learned Standing Counsel. In the absence
of any vacancy reserved for S.C. Category
candidate, petitioner cannot be appointed.
In such view of the matter, the
Contempt Petition is closed.
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.)
Arpan 18.11.2019
